arm_order: control then ple sequentially on the same physical GPU6
failure_policy: One prospectively corrected control→PLE stage only; no further retry. Stop on numerical, memory, timeout or cost failure; preserve all telemetry/logs. No fixture, model, precision, learning-rate, scaler initialization, optimizer, update ordering, warmup length or candidate-only batch change.

resources.monitor_note: External orchestration must log process identity, elapsed, sampled group RSS and NVML GPU process memory. Torch allocator cap is enforced, RSS/NVML sampling is not a cgroup limit and can miss between-sample peaks. Deadlines terminate only the owned process group; preserve exit reason and partial logs.

launch_precondition.policy: Check immediately before each arm. Prelaunch occupancy failure is no launch; do not displace other users. Occupancy during a launched arm is a failed contaminated attempt, without favorable timing filtering.

parent_recipe.weighting: propensity squared +.03; actual mask replacement; since32 floor.25
parent_recipe.prefetch: raw, targets, scored, propensity clone resident

numerical_policy.TF32: Do not change ordinary global policy; record matmul/cudnn allow_tf32, benchmark, deterministic and float32_matmul_precision. Disabled autocast for adapter is not a full-mantissa matmul guarantee.
numerical_policy.initial_parity: Same ordinary initialized tensors/CPU+CUDA RNG; initial AMP outputs, hidden and unclipped old parameter gradients numerical exactness on generated 32x2000 inputs; no signed-zero byte or first-update parity claim.
numerical_policy.scalar_CUDA: 97 independent literal oracle rows including subnormal/adjacent/extreme intervals exact aggregate; independent float64 triangular basis table VJP on boundary and 2048 repeated rows max_abs<2e-4, relative_RMS<2e-5 with denominator max(RMS(expected),1e-12).
numerical_policy.training: Every step finite loss. Warmup0/1/2 may skip iff scaler reduces, all model parameters remain finite and numerically exact unchanged, optimizer moments/counters unchanged or absent→finitezero on first skipped allocation. Counters equal completed updates. Every measured step3..9 requires finite loss/norm, no scaler reduction, actual counter+1 for every parameter and some model parameter change. Preserve unconditional original scheduler/EMA operations even on skippedsteps. Final model/EMA/optimizer finite; PLE table/projection changed, immutable scalar buffers unchanged. Flush raw step telemetry before assertions and audit results afterward.
numerical_policy.audit_timing: Parameter and optimizer CPU readbacks occur strictly outside the original timed forward/backward/update region; snapshots do not consume RNG or modify training tensors. All seven original timed steps retained, no favorable filter. Readback overhead contributes to overall stage walltime but not ordinary update median.

gate.memory: Same absolute reserved<=5.5GiB, external GPU<=5632MiB, sampled groupRSS<=8GiB; no OOM/timeout/nonfinite loss or failed state/counter audit. Standard scaler backoff allowed only original warmup0/1/2. No backoff during all7 measured updates.
gate.timing: All seven postwarmup step wall times enter the median; report all ten including warmups, no favorable filtering.
gate.cost_interpretation: Two GPUs for eight screening parents (four control/four candidate), then one final candidate parent; 25% parent margin plus90min reserve for nine H2 fits, prediction/native checks and delivery. Require upper bound <= remaining wall seconds at completed probe. This is a feasibility estimate, not a measured full-training guarantee.
gate.no_fit_automatic_authorization: Passing this preflight only permits root to consider separate train-only knots/native-runtime/forecastfit allocations.
gate.independent_cutoffs: Formula does not waive fixed parent start cutoffs or final verification reserve.

diff_proof.changes: Extra v2 authorization flag, CPU-only pre-step snapshot outside timing, per-step flushed telemetry/readback validation replacing invalid warmup finite-gradient requirement, final state audits/metadata. Model/fixture/numeric training operations remain unchanged.

numeric_criterion_correction: Original ordinary-control diagnostic replay had finite loss and GradScaler-detected nonfinite gradients at initial65536 scale. Allow unchanged standard scaler skip only during original warmup0,1,2. This corrects preparation handling, does not change production training or establish original undocumented failure state.
initialization_and_schedule: Same initial GradScaler65536, ordinary OneCycle15000 and unconditional original scheduler/EMA order. Ten original2000row chunks, no extra stabilization steps.
